title: Monday Morning Brief
one_line: Produce the weekly operating brief: what moved, what is at risk, and the three things that need a decision.
description: Produce the weekly operating brief: what moved, what is at risk, and the three things that need a decision. Use when someone wants a Monday update, a weekly business summary, or a recurring brief across their tools.
paragraph: A weekly brief is only read if it is short and if it is honest about what it could not see. This skill pulls from whatever is connected, reports movement rather than levels, names the decisions that are waiting, and states plainly which sources were unavailable rather than quietly leaving them out.
approval_stop: sending the brief to anyone outside the operator

requirements.item: Connectors in your agent for the sources the brief reads (calendar, mail, CRM, finance, tracker)
requirements.cost: None beyond the tools you already use.

requirements_summary: Needs connectors in your agent for the sources the brief reads (calendar, mail, CRM, finance, tracker).
